SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION COLLECTED POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS FROM THE LOCALS AND FROM MEMBERS'S PAYROLL DEDUCTIONS. THESE FUNDS WERE PROMPTLY TRANSFERRED TO THE SEPARATE POLITICAL ORGANIZATION.

CWA IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAX UNDER SECTION 501(C)(5) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE. CWA IS ALSO EXEMPT UNDER SECTION 47 OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA CODE. ACCORDINGLY, NO PROVISIONS HAVE BEEN MADE FOR INCOME TAXES. CWA'S FORMS 990, RETURN OF ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX, AND FORM 990-T, EXEMPT ORGANIZATION UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME TAX RETURN, FOR THE YEARS ENDED MAY 31, 2021 THROUGH 2023 ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY THE IRS, GENERALLY FOR THREE YEARS AFTER THEY WERE FILED. CWA FOLLOWS THE PROVISIONS OF U.S. GENERALLY ACCEPTED ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES REGARDING ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES. THE PROVISIONS PRESCRIBE A RECOGNITION THRESHOLD AND MEASUREMENT PRINCIPLES FOR THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS RECOGNITION AND MEASUREMENT OF TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN ON A TAX RETURN THAT ARE NOT CERTAIN TO BE REALIZED. THIS HAD NO IMPACT ON CWA'S FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE MEMBERS OF THE ORGANIZATION ARE THE DELEGATES ELECTED BY THE LOCAL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THEIR RESPECTIVE BYLAWS OR RULES. EACH LOCAL MAY ELECT AN ALTERNATE DELEGATE FOR EACH DELEGATE ELECTED WHO SHALL ATTEND THE CONVENTION IN THE EVENT THE DELEGATE IS UNABLE TO ATTEND.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A LOCAL DELEGATE HAS ONE VOTE BY SECRET BALLOT IN THE CONVENTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: DURING THE CONVENTION, THE LOCAL DELEGATE(S) HAVE ONE VOTE ON DECISIONS OF THE GOVERNING BODY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990 IS DRAFTED THROUGH A COLLABORATIVE EFFORT OF THE ORGANIZATION'S OUTSIDE AUDIT FIRM AND IN-HOUSE FINANCIAL AND LEGAL PROFESSIONALS. THE DRAFT IS DISTRIBUTED TO THE CWA EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO FILING. THE FORM IS THEN FINALIZED AND SUBMITTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COMPENSATION OF THE TOP OFFICIALS AND OTHER OFFICERS ARE DETERMINED BY COMPARABILITY DATA AND REVIEWED BY THE BOARD APPOINTED BUDGET COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S DOCUMENTS ARE NOT AVAILABLE TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC. THE ORGANIZATION MAKES DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE TO MEMBERS UPON REQUEST.
